CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee Meeting will be
held on Wednesday February 15, 2023, commencing at 7:00 P.M. at Alhambra City Hall 111 South First Street,
Alhambra, California via video conference.

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE

Consistent with AB 361, the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting will not be physically open to the public,
although the public may participate by video conference or teleconference and all Commission members will
participate via video conference or teleconference rather than attend in person.

Watch and listen to the meeting via Zoom Webinar:

Zoom Webinar direct link: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/85796954683?pwd=MGhXeHNtcllxM3NxM055c2xRRWR0QT09

Webinar ID: 857 9695 4683  Passcode: 807808

Or by telephone by dialing (877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475 4499 US Toll-free, 833 548 0276 US Toll-free, 833 548 0282
US Toll-free entering Webinar ID: 857 9695 4683 and Passcode: 807808. Please Note: All members of the public calling or
logging into the meeting will be muted so that the meeting can proceed.

Addressing the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission:

Via Zoom or Telephone: “Raise your hand” - Members of the public may speak by using the “Raise Hand” function during
the public comments portion, if on Zoom or telephone. Staff will unmute speakers participating via Zoom or telephone and
announce your name when it is your time to speak.

Remarks are limited to 5 minutes; however, the presiding officer may either extend or reduce the maximum time to such period
of time as the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission may determine.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to
the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your name. You should then join into the meeting 10 minutes
prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will announce to you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to
speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.

As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no later than 5:00 P.M.
on Wednesday February 15, 2023 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then
be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the President’s
discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the
comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.

Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should e-mail or call
Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their best efforts to provide reasonable
accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of
video conference meetings, all participants are encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

Notice No: N2M23-21

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.

City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE
  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, January 18, 2023
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:01 P.M. on Wednesday, January 18, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, via Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: President Canseco-Chan, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, Commission Member Jimenez, and Commission Member Massaro.
Committee Members Absent: None.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE NOVEMBER 16, 2022 REGULAR C.A.C.E.
MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Hermano,
the minutes from the November 16, 2022 regular meeting were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Vice President Saunders and Alhambra City Council Member Sasha Renee Perez are reviewing
two muralists for District 4. President Canseco Chan and Alhambra City Council Member Ross
Maza are comparing possible locations and types of public art for District 2. Commission
Member Massaro will provide a revised budget for the proposed art installation and supplies
after speaking with the Academy of Special Dreams for District 1. Commission Member Jimenez
and Mayor Andrade-Stadler have been discussing a youth student art contest to paint the
electricity boxes in District 5, Commission Member Jimenez will return with more details at the
next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton and Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared photographs from the
2022 Holiday Home Decorating Contest, 2023 Tournament of Roses Parade and invited the City
Arts and Cultural Arts Commission to attend the upcoming Lunar New Year, Bunny Hop and
Arbor Day events.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
None.

ADJOURNMENT
 With a motion by President Canseco Chan and seconded by Vice President Saunders, the January
18, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:29 P.M.
